encoding_variations: required_use — RESPA prohibits requiring use of an affiliate except narrow exceptions (lender may require its own attorney, credit report, or appraisal). A 'required use = yes' is only lawful with an exception; required_use_exception_or_discount is the disambiguator
estimated charge — a point estimate ('$450') or a range ('$400-$600') or 'varies'; no money coercer fits a range, keep the estimated-charge cell as str inside the nested row
AfBA vs ABA — 'Affiliated Business Arrangement' and 'Affiliated Business Disclosure' name the same RESPA form; classification handles it
free-to-shop language — mandatory statement wording varies slightly; degrade the boolean to str and keep the sentence

notes: Serves 0 rules — no rule in the packet names this document; it is the RESPA Section 8 Affiliated Business Arrangement disclosure. Fields justified by identity, processor use, and compliance review.

14 typed-core rows — appropriate for a single-purpose disclosure. Compliance fields (required-use, free-to-shop, acknowledgment, signatures) are the processor's review points; the affiliate detail lives in the nested list.

This is the RESPA Section 8(c)(4) Affiliated Business Arrangement (AfBA) disclosure — its purpose is to disclose that the referring party has an ownership/affiliate interest in a provider it is referring, and the estimated charges. The mandatory borrower protections are the free-to-shop statement and the general prohibition on required use.

No new _PII_FIELDS registration proposed — the ABA disclosure carries consumer names and a property reference, all standard sensitivity (identity), and no SSN/account/DOB. If a specific loan/account number appears in property_address_or_loan_reference, treat per the confidential loan-number convention, not the catch-all.
